nom: Avène Cicalfate+ Skin Recovery Emulsion, Post-Procedure, 1.3 Fl Oz

avis.texte: I hate that I love this product. It's stupid expensive. But it's great for broken/damaged/recovering skin. I've used it post microneedling and it is the only thing that soothes, hydrates, and doesn't sting raw, red skin. Great for rashes/hives and allergic reactions too. Luckily a thin layer is often enough to do the trick. so it lasts a long time I wouldn't use for everyday moisture, but when your skin is angry, this stuff works. (Overpriced? Yes. Witchcraft? Maybe. Does it work? Yep.)

avis.titre: Good product but importantGood product but important
avis.texte: This product is a gentle barrier healing cream great for sensitive skin. But I need to say something, in stores this product has a foil safety seal on the tube and neither of the 2 I have received from here that say shipped and sold by amazon off the brand’s official storefront have foil safety seals on the tube (under the cap) and I want to know ehy. The other Avène cicalfate cream does have the foil safety seal so I went to a local pharmacy and had them open up a box and check the tube of this and while price was fully priced, it had a safety seal. This bothers me a lot. They are taking down reviews that try to report that a product comes without a safety seal that should have one but I would like to contact Avène about this. It’s a GREAT product. A wonderful cream. But if it has safety seal in stores but not here, WHY? As proof I have shown photos, the one with the safety seal came from my local pharmacy

Really love this one. I was using the thicker version but I really don't like the smell of it! This is truly fragrance free and has a zinc feel. I will make a mask out of this when my skin is super dry. Everyone is complaining about the price but if youve been through 10s of moisturizers, you know this is very affordable. Very moisturizing and doesnt break me out.

AMAZING Hydration and barrier repair!! I actually use this very often on my face and have been for a few months now. I started using it because I had a laser treatment at a med spa. This product helped immensely! It reduced the irritation, soothed my skin a lot, and made the overall healing process much more tolerable. I now use it every night to keep my skin hydrated and help with my very sensitive skin. I would say start with a thinner layer of the product . If I put too much on in can clog my pores a little bit. It has a very smooth texture that feels luxurious when applying. Soaks into skin well. Light to no smell. Not greesy. I put this on at night and my face feels softer and less irritated by morning. A+
I tried so many different moisturizers to help with dry and peeling skin from using tretinoin and this is the only one that actually worked! Expensive for a small bottle but worth it
Nice for after skin peel or reddish face. I used after a skin treatment and it helped heal it much quicker.

Have used this product for years. It is a winner. Great in the winter. Great for using after any sort of procedure. I have had my face lasered at the dermatologist and it helps things heal so quickly and well. Love it. Will always use it

avis.titre: I love Avene Skin Recovery Emulsion for post procedure calming
avis.texte: I use this after my trips to the med-spa where I may get botox injections and fillers. This product provides a good skin barrier as you are healing.
Hab was für nach dem Micorneedling gesucht und gefunden. Super Inhaltsstoffe und super beruhigend! Empfehle ich!

fast deliery even from oversea. It is healing balm with the consistency of a light, soothing lotion. I can feel sinks recovery in instantly after using it. Althoug the produce name sounds like a very specific and niche use case, it’s actually great for all-around skin-soothing.
Hidrata y calma la piel. Para después de tratamientos donde la piel queda frágil o irritada. Se distribuyen fácil, tarda un poco en absorverse. Es muy buena.

avis.titre: got this for my acne scars!
avis.texte: I got this cream to help with the scars I have after my acnes! and used them every night for a week! and I can say definitely they improved!

I tried this after my last chemical peel and it worked better than any other cream I’ve ever tried. It’s not greasy and my skin looks great thanks to the hydration. I liked the product so much I put it into my daily routine and wear it under my makeup. It has no smell and is lightweight.

It seems to be a good product and it’s not too heavy , but still caused few breakouts here and there . Also, Avenue always has protective foil on their cream , this one didn’t have (I replaced it but new one also didn’t have it). Also, it goes away really fast because it’s only 1.3 ounces.

avis.titre: Not sealed used or previously opened products
avis.texte: Was shocked when I received this. Box was damaged, not sealed and zero seal on the tube when I opened. All Avene products come sealed for hygiene and sterility; this bottle was not sealed but was opened indicating the product had been opened and/or used and the box was damaged. Can’t use because I don’t know what is really in the bottle. Waste of money for fake/used product.

avis.titre: El producto venía abierto otra vez. No creo que es seguro aplicarlo en la cara así.
avis.texte: La cambié porque no viene con el sello de seguridad. Desafortunadamente la que me mandaron vino igual y huele horrible no me gustó.
